messages:
anna_partnerships: Quick brainstorm: propose a 'stability rebate' for marketplace private offers. small upfront credit + staged deeper discount if committed usage stays within a defined band. aims: reduce month-to-month cliffs, give OEMs predictable rebates, and better SI launch signals.

josh_sales: Field would love predictability. how do we prevent gaming (big warmup spikes)?

anna_partnerships: baseline calc excludes first 14 days of a new launch and ignores top 5% outlier days. vest window 60-90d.

megan_legal: need clear expiry, non-transferable credits, and termination handling. also define "band" precisely.

rafi_hw: OEM ask: only pay hardware rebates after appliance share >= 55% for vest window. monthly visibility ok, payout quarterly.

tom_finance: finance prefers monthly amortization of credits, cap per account = max(monthly_commit*3, 3000). reserve for disputes.

anna_partnerships: ops notes: billing fields required: credit_balance, vest_start, appliance_share_pct, rebate_flag. minimal dev ETA 2w + 1w QA.

ci_bot: docs branch updated with pilot docs. preview link: https://docs-preview.redwood/incentives

anna_partnerships: pilot plan: 6 weeks, 2 SI offers + 1 OEM bundle. metrics: MoM variance, dispute rate, OEM reconciliation hours. quick config snippet to copy:

```
stability_rebate_config:
  upfront_credit_pct: 0.02
  vest_days: 75
  stability_band_pct: 20
  appliance_share_threshold: 0.55
  token_cap_formula: "max(monthly_commit*3,3000)"
  credit_apply: "monthly"
  rebate_payout: "quarterly"
```

anna_partnerships: assigning follow-ups: josh recruit partners (ETA 5d), megan legal clauses (ETA 3d), tom confirm P&L reserve (ETA 4d), rafi OEM reconciliation spec (ETA 5d). reconvene next Wed.
